# NSPanel HAUI 0.4.5

This release adds a live preview of the panel to the editor, moves firmware
updates into the integration, and brings Day/Night profiles, a configurable
inside-temperature sensor and several notification fixes.

## Highlights

- **Live preview in the editor** — the new **Live preview** button
  (`mdi:television-play`) opens an interactive virtual panel for the selected
  device, rendered from the real hub code: tap, drag and swipe with mouse or
  finger, press the hardware buttons, trigger the idle timeout. **Sandbox mode**
  (the default) simulates every entity change; **Live mode** calls Home
  Assistant, including the panel's relays from the hardware buttons, except for
  the panel's settings. A **Show entities** switch names the entity under the
  mouse. The preview fires no events for automations and never installs
  updates. Contributed by
  [@jameshiscott](https://github.com/jameshiscott) in
  [#85](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/pull/85) and
  [#86](https://github.com/happydasch/nspanel_haui/pull/86).
- **Long press to go back** — Clock, ClockTwo and Weather panels have no header
  buttons and could only be left by swiping. The new **Long press to go back**
  panel option (Advanced section) goes back on a one-second hold anywhere: to
  the panel this one was opened from, or to the home panel. Also contributed by
  [@jameshiscott](https://github.com/jameshiscott).
- **Firmware updates moved to the integration** — the **HAUI Firmware** update
  entity now lives in the integration, reads the release manifest itself and
  installs through the firmware's `install_firmware_url` action.
- **Day/Night Profiles** — each device can select Day and Night display settings
  by a fixed local window or Home Assistant sunrise/sunset with minute offsets.
  Profiles cover brightness, dimming, page/idle target and display-off behavior;
  the independent Sleep schedule keeps its existing precedence.
- **Inside temperature sensor picker** — clock and weather panels can use any
  `sensor` entity for the inside temperature; leave empty for the NSPanel's
  internal sensor.
- **Notification fixes and options** — optional `timeout` auto-dismiss,
  multi-line text renders its line breaks, and the alarm panel gains action
  button options (hidden arm modes, action icons, text/background colours).

## Before updating

- **The display TFT follows the firmware manifest.** The editor's TFT picker
  lists only the manifest's TFT (plus **From URL**); installing an older
  release's TFT by version is no longer possible.
- **Panels on firmware 0.4.2 or earlier must be updated once by hand** (ESPHome
  or **Install firmware → From URL**), because their firmware lacks the
  `install_firmware_url` action.
- **Custom firmware builds fail closed.** A custom build reports its variant and
  is never offered or installed the public universal release image; flash the
  new release once by hand, then the hub can update it again.
- A test panel that followed local test releases through the firmware
  `firmware_manifest_url` substitution needs the new **Firmware manifest URL**
  device setting instead.

See [Upgrading → Firmware updates](docs/upgrading.md#11-firmware-updates-moved-to-the-integration)
for the full migration steps.

## Known limits

- The live preview renders fonts with Home Assistant's Roboto sized to the
  Nextion's, so text can sit a pixel or two differently from the panel.
- The preview shows the saved config; reopen it after saving.
